profile.name: Adithyan T
profile.bio: I build Go backend services, React platforms and AI-powered internal tools, and ship them to Kubernetes.

bullets: Owned the Go backend for an internal analytics platform used by 80+ employees and leadership: company data, embedded Datadog dashboards, Claude usage across the org, and an AI chatbot that answers questions from Datadog with streaming responses
Owned the support service in Armada's Bridge platform, letting users raise tickets, with role-based access and workflows for assignment and resolution
Built frontend workflows for a multi-tenant IaaS/PaaS platform for edge datacenters: VM provisioning, cluster creation, resource allocation and AI model deployment
Built quarterly GitHub engineering reports with Gemini multi-agent workflows, and an internal React component library (Storybook, MUI) meeting WCAG 2.0 A & AA
Set up CI/CD for Go services with GitHub Actions, deploying to Azure Kubernetes Service with Managed Identity and Key Vault
Built features for an ERP platform with role-based access control and multi-level user workflows
Turned design prototypes into responsive, reusable components with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS
